messages:
Jon (Sales): Quick handoff for Pelago Systems — demo ✅. Main asks: Okta SSO, private-eval for PII data, embeddings for semantic search, and a short pilot (3 weeks). Renewal risk: low today but pilot timeline is tight; if pilot extends, cost/quotas could be a signal. I’m tagging owners below and adding context.
Maria (CS): Thanks @Jon. I’ll own the kickoff + enablement. @Nora will handle success metrics and feedback capture. Can you drop the PM/technical contact and any SSO docs?
Li (Solutions Eng): Notes from the demo: model selection leaning toward a smaller Llama-like open model for latency, but customer wants embed quality for search. Recommend starting hosted for speed, then a dedicated/private eval for PII. Key infra asks: allowlist IPs, egress to our inference endpoints, and an Okta OIDC callback. Sample quick-provision config below (for private eval):
```
{
  "deployment": "private-eval",
  "gpu": "a10g",
  "model": "llama-2-13b-q4",
  "quantization": "bitsandbytes-8",
  "network": {
    "allowed_ips": ["54.23.11.8/32"],
    "egress": true
  },
  "ssoprovider": "okta",
  "callback": "https://pelago.example.com/auth/callback"
}
```
Li (Solutions Eng): Also: ask Pelago for a small sample dataset (100 docs) so we can run embeddings perf and cost approx. That will drive batching/kv cache tuning.
Sam (Support): Filed SUP-6721 for SSO + network egress prework. Ticket: https://redwood.internal/support/SUP-6721 — assigned to @Sam and @Li. We need the tenant ID & Okta metadata XML from Pelago.
Nora (CS Ops): Onboarding + feedback plan (high level): 1) Kickoff + access (week 0) 2) Private eval + ingest (week 1) 3) Pilot QA + success metrics (week 2) 4) Retrospective + finances (week 3). Metric asks: search MRR lift proxy, avg tokens per query, error rate. I’ll create the feedback form to capture prompt drift and quality signals.
Jon (Sales): Pelago contacts: PM = emily@pelago.co, Eng lead = rishi@pelago.co. Target pilot start: 2026-04-06. Emily can share Okta metadata and a subset of documents. I'll join kickoff — available Tue/Wed mornings PT.
Maria (CS): Proposed kickoff: Tue 2026-04-07 10:00 PT. Agenda: 15m intros, 20m SSO & network checklist, 20m ingestion plan, 5m next steps. @Jon can you confirm with Emily?
Jon (Sales): Confirmed with Emily — she’s good for 4/7 10:00 PT. I'll send calendar invite and include the Okta metadata ahead of time.
Li (Solutions Eng): For the sample ingestion, please include: (1) 100 representative docs, (2) expected query volume, (3) any redaction rules. Also send a sample PR that triggers an embedding call (curl example below):

curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/embeddings \\n  -H \"Authorization: Bearer <TOKEN>\" \\\n  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \\\n  -d '{"model":"embed-2-small","input": ["doc text sample"]}'

Sam (Support): Added renewal-watch tag to SUP-6721: "pilot-budget-sensitivity" — if usage jumps >30% of estimate, CS and RevOps get paged. :warning: 
Nora (CS Ops): I’ll prep the feedback survey and a short eval rubric (relevance, latency, hallucination rate). Will post draft here before kickoff.
calendar-bot: Calendar event created: Pelago Kickoff — 2026-04-07T17:00:00Z (organizer: Maria (CS))
Maria (CS): Owners + next steps summary:
- Maria (CS): kickoff, enablement, primary CS owner
- Nora (CS Ops): success metrics, feedback form, retrospective
- Li (Solutions Eng): private-eval setup, perf testing
- Sam (Support): SSO & network ticket SUP-6721, support standby
- Jon (Sales): customer contact, pilot scope confirmation
Please confirm owners and anything missing. I’ll spin up the onboarding doc in the CS workspace and link it in the invite.
Jon (Sales): Owners confirmed. One ask: can Solutions provide a rough cost estimate for 3-week pilot (tokens + dedicated eval overhead) before kickoff? Helps the customer with procurement.
Li (Solutions Eng): Will run a small perf/cost sim once we get sample docs — aim to post numbers by 2026-04-05 EOD.
Sam (Support): Noted. I’ll update SUP-6721 with the Okta metadata when Emily sends it. If network needs a change window, we’ll coordinate ops.
Nora (CS Ops): Great — I’ll circulate the feedback link and a short prep checklist for Pelago (credentials, sample docs, expected traffic, success metric owners).
